description:
You are a curious child with a house full of interactive objects and a list of simple missions to complete. This level-based simulator is designed for straightforward, relaxed gameplay from a child's perspective on the floor. You have complete freedom to crawl, walk, and climb through cozy indoor rooms and sunny backyard gardens, transforming everyday domestic spaces into your personal playground.

This puzzle adventure offers unique and lighthearted challenges at each level. Some missions have you hunting down hidden toys, while others require you to use your wits to reach high places. Use smooth controls to navigate the stylized 3D environment and complete objectives such as finding hidden toys, solving simple puzzles, and setting up harmless, funny pranks to surprise your mom.
